fields.name: Tile1
fields.fieldText:
This guide will walk you through the proper identification and resolution of a RingCentral Business (SMS) issue. Each SMS issue should be handled individually and all information you've gathered must be recorded in the case. PREREQUISITES Before you start following this guide, please ensure that ALL of the following settings are correct:
  • User Extension Status Must be Enabled or Not Activated.
  • HIPAA Conduit Setting Must NOT been abled. The HIPAA Conduit Setting will disable texting including both Business SMS and Glip Messages through the applicable RingCentral Office, Fax, or Professional accounts.
  • The account must have a Local RingCentral Number associated to the User Extension.
RingCentral Business SMS can only be sent from or received by Local RingCentral Numbers. Sending SMS from or receiving SMS by Toll-free RingCentral Numbers is currently not supported. Before proceeding, ensure that all of the above requirements are met. They are critical to ensure that inbound and outbound SMS will work. Note: In the event that you encounter a road block when using this guide, please ask assistance from a Team Lead.

fields.name: tile4e4
fields.fieldText:
DETERMINE WHAT EXTENSION THE RECEIVING LOCAL NUMBER IS ASSIGNED Below are the inbound SMS rules being followed when using RingCentral Business SMS:
  • SMS messages sent to the main number will be delivered to the Operator Extension.
  • SMS messages sent to a local number assigned to the Auto-Receptionist will be delivered the Operator Extension.
  • SMS messages sent to a local number assigned to a user extension will only be delivered to the same user extension it is assigned with.
  • Any local number in the account whose SMS Enabled status is Not Enabled will not receive SMS messages.

fields.name: What_extension_is_the_receiving_local_number_assigned

screens.name: DETERMINE_WHERE_THE_ISSUE_IS_ENCOUNTERED
screens.label: DETERMINE WHERE THE ISSUE IS ENCOUNTERED

fields.name: tile4c4
fields.fieldText:
DETERMINE WHERE THE ISSUE IS ENCOUNTERED If the reported failed outbound SMS are not showing on the SMS Messages tool, this indicates that the application being used to send the SMS message is failing to relay the information to the RingCentral server. Below are the different applications where SMS messages can be sent from: SOFTPHONE (RingCentral for Desktop)
  • RingCentral for Desktop is an easy-to-use app, and a comprehensive communications hub with all-inclusive phone, fax, business SMS, and conferencing for your desktop. It provides an intuitive interface that optimizes user experience and increases productivity.
  • To know more about the RingCentral for Desktop, please visit: RingCentral for Desktop Overview
MOBILE APPLICATION (RingCentral Mobile Application for IOS and Android)
  • The RingCentral Mobile Application is a smartphone software that empowers users to take voice, fax, text, HD video meetings, and conferencing with them anywhere and anytime.
  • To know more about the RingCentral Mobile Application, please visit: RingCentral Mobile Application Overview
INTEGRATIONS
  • RingCentral App for Salesforce
    • The RingCentral App for Salesforce provides seamless integration between the RingCentral phone system and Salesforce.
    • It enhances the CRM experience with integrated cloud business communications including SMS, improving workforce productivity, increasing call efficiency, and enhancing customer interaction.
  • RingCentral for Microsoft Office 365
    • RingCentral for Microsoft Office 365 TM seamlessly integrates business communications into the cloud work environment.
    • Using Google Chrome, it transforms Microsoft Office 365 into an enterprise-grade communications hub with a powerful and easy-to-use interface that is very simple for end-users to deploy and IT to manage.
  • RingCentral for Google
    • RingCentral for Google provides seamless integration between a Google account and RingCentral services.
    • It offers these features such as:
      • Use Google Chrome browser on any platform (Windows, Mac and Chromebook).
      • Make or receive calls through the RingCentral phone system directly from your Gmail account.
      • Find Google and RingCentral contacts combined together in an easy to search screen.
      • Enable click-to-dial on any phone number on in your Gmail, allowing the user to spend more time servicing clients and less time dialing.
      • Send or receive text messages and see them as conversations.
      • Listen to your voicemails directly from the browser.
      • View calls made, received or missed.
      • Schedule RingCentral Conference and RingCentral Meetings from the user's Google Calendar.
      • Integrate RingCentral Conferencing with Google Hangouts to allow participants to dial right into a Hangout.
  • RingCentral for Outlook
    • RingCentral for Outlook provides seamless integration between Microsoft Outlook and RingCentral services, thus increasing user productivity.
    • It allows the user to conveniently view messages, make calls, exchange text conversation, and to create and schedule an online meeting or conference call right from Outlook.

screens.name: DETERMINE_WHICH_DIRECT_EXTENSION_THE_LOCAL_NUMBER_IS_ASSIGNED_TO
screens.label: DETERMINE WHICH DIRECT EXTENSION THE LOCAL NUMBER IS ASSIGNED TO

fields.name: tile5cd
fields.fieldText:
DETERMINE WHICH DIRECT EXTENSION THE LOCAL NUMBER IS ASSIGNED TO SMS messages sent to a local number assigned to a user extension will only be delivered to the same user extension it is assigned with. This being said, it will be best to identify the direct extension the local number is assigned to before proceeding to the next steps. Below are the steps to identify the direct extension of the local number:
  • Log in to the account as the administrator from Admin Interface.
  • Under Phone System, click Phone Numbers.
  • Click Assigned, then the page will display the phone numbers and the direct extensions they are assigned to.
Confirm with the receiving local number is assigned to the correct user extension. If not, assign it to the desired extension then press Done. NOTE: If the local number is attached to a DigitalLine, you can switch the user extension it is currently assigned with by going to Phones & Devices. ENSURE THAT THE CUSTOMER IS LOGGED IN TO THE CORRECT USER EXTENSION Have the customer log out of the current extension in the RingCentral application they are using, then relog-in using the direct extension. Once logged in, send a test SMS to the customer's number.

fields.name: tile3c6
fields.fieldText:
If outbound SMS messages are still not being shown in the SMS Messages tool even after temporarily disabling both security software and firewall, this means that RingCentral may be experiencing problems processing the SMS message. This should be further diagnosed by Tier 2. Escalate the case to Tier 2. Reminders before escalating the case:
  • Gather all failed outbound SMS samples and include them in your case notes.
    • Format:SendertoLocal RingCentral Number atDate/Time (Pacific)
    • Example: Sender: 13237657676 to Recipient: 13238252222 at 05/05/2017 03:44PM
  • Gather all computer information including the Operating System.
  • Ensure that your case notes are detailed and concise.
  • Set expectations with the customer regarding their case being escalated.
  • Do not forget to select the correct SMS Disposition based on the issue being escalated.
  • Use probing questions to determine if the customer has any other unresolved issues. Take ownership and appropriate action to ensure unresolved issues are handled correctly.

fields.name: tile3c4
fields.fieldText:

fields.name: tile3
fields.fieldText:
GENERAL ACTIVATION OF BUSINESS SMS RingCentral customers will not be able to send or receive SMS messages if the Local RingCentral Number's SMS feature is Not Enabled. This can easily be identified by going to the Phone Numbers section in Admin Interface. The SMS Enabled column in Admin Interface will show the status of the local number's SMS messaging service. PORTED NUMBERS VS. NON-PORTED NUMBERS The SMS feature of ported numbers will take 72 hours to activate (from the date and time of completion) while non-ported numbers should have the SMS feature activated from the get go. If the status of the local number's SMS feature is Not Enabled, check if the number has just recently been ported in.
  • Check the account's Cases in Salesforce for the local number's port in request. Port in requests are cases created under Case Record Type: Porting In (RC).
  • Look into the cases and validate if the port in request was for the reported local number. If you cannot find any port in case for the particular local number, this means that the local number is non-ported.

fields.name: tile5f
fields.fieldText: GATHER INFORMATION OF THE FAILED OUTBOUND SMS MESSAGES NOTE: RingCentral Business SMS cannot receive and send to Short Code numbers. Short codes are short digit sequences, significantly shorter than telephone numbers, that are widely used for value-added services such as charity donations, mobile services, web services, ordering ringtones, and television program voting. To further investigate if outbound SMS are indeed failing you will need to check if outbound SMS messages are being processed in our server. This can be found by using the SMS Messages function in Admin Interface. This tool will be useful in diagnosing SMS-related issues. USING THE SMS MESSAGES TOOL Ask the customer the phone number(s) they had problems sending the SMS messages to as well as the estimated time and date the SMS messages were sent. Once you have the data, check if the SMS messages reported would show up on the SMS Messages tool. Note: The SMS Messages tool will show all outbound and inbound SMS messages in the account that was processed by RingCentral. Any SMS transmission that will not be available in the SMS Messages tool means that the SMS was not sent by or received by RingCentral. The image below shows a successful inbound SMS from 18319050378 to 18316235550 on 04/26/2017 at 04:31:52 PM. Note: The time and date of the information shown in the SMS Messages tool follow the Pacific Timezone.

fields.name: tile3c
fields.fieldText: GATHER INFORMATION OF THE FAILED OUTBOUND SMS MESSAGES NOTE: RingCentral Business SMS cannot receive and send to Short Code numbers. Short codes are short digit sequences, significantly shorter than telephone numbers, that are widely used for value-added services such as charity donations, mobile services, web services, ordering ringtones, and television program voting. To further investigate if outbound SMS are indeed failing you will need to check if outbound SMS messages are being processed in our server. This can be found by using the SMS Messages function in Admin Interface. This tool will be useful in diagnosing SMS-related issues. USING THE SMS MESSAGES TOOL Ask the customer the phone number(s) they had problems sending the SMS messages to as well as the estimated time and date the SMS messages were sent. Once you have the data, check if the SMS messages reported would show up on the SMS Messages tool. Note: The SMS Messages tool will show all outbound and inbound SMS messages in the account that was processed by RingCentral. Any SMS transmission that will not be available in the SMS Messages tool means that the SMS was not sent by or received by RingCentral. The image below shows a successful outbound SMS from 18316235550 to 18319050378 on 04/26/2017 at 08:28:35 AM. Note: The time and date of the information shown in the SMS Messages tool follow the Pacific Timezone.

fields.fieldText:
DETERMINE WHERE THE ISSUE IS ENCOUNTERED RINGCENTRAL APP FOR SALESFORCE
  • The RingCentral App for Salesforce provides seamless integration between the RingCentral phone system and Salesforce.
  • It enhances the CRM experience with integrated cloud business communications including SMS, improving workforce productivity, increasing call efficiency, and enhancing customer interaction.
RINGCENTRAL FOR MICROSOFT OFFICE365
  • RingCentral for Microsoft Office 365 TM seamlessly integrates business communications into the cloud work environment.
  • Using Google Chrome, it transforms Microsoft Office 365 into an enterprise-grade communications hub with a powerful and easy-to-use interface that is very simple for end-users to deploy and IT to manage.
RINGCENTRAL FOR GOOGLE
  • RingCentral for Google provides seamless integration between a Google account and RingCentral services. It offers these features such as:
    • Use Google Chrome browser on any platform (Windows, Mac and Chromebook).
    • Make or receive calls through the RingCentral phone system directly from your Gmail account.
    • Find Google and RingCentral contacts combined together in an easy to search screen.
    • Enable click-to-dial on any phone number on in your Gmail, allowing the user to spend more time servicing clients and less time dialing.
    • Send or receive text messages and see them as conversations.
    • Listen to your voicemails directly from the browser.
    • View calls made, received or missed.
    • Schedule RingCentral Conference and RingCentral Meetings from the user's Google Calendar.
    • Integrate RingCentral Conferencing with Google Hangouts to allow participants to dial right into a Hangout.
RINGCENTRAL FOR OUTLOOK
  • RingCentral for Outlook provides seamless integration between Microsoft Outlook and RingCentral services, thus increasing user productivity.
  • It allows the user to conveniently view messages, make calls, exchange text conversation, and to create and schedule an online meeting or conference call right from Outlook.

fields.name: tile2
fields.fieldText:
ISSUE IDENTIFICATION SMS issues vary depending on the symptoms customers are reporting. Below are the most common issues being reported and their corresponding symptoms: GENERAL ACTIVATION OF A BUSINESS SMS NUMBER Symptoms:
  • Sending SMS messages result to an error showing up as "Cannot Send Message: A Valid Phone Number is required to send text messages to recipients outside your company. Please contact your Administrator to add a direct number to youraccount."
  • The SMS Enabled column in Admin Interface shows the local number as Not Enabled.
  • SMS/MMS Feature is OFF on Admin Interface. Click Account Info, scroll down to SMS/MMS Feature Avalability
UNDESIRABLE SMS SENDING AND RECEIVING BEHAVIORS General outbound SMS failures Symptoms:
  • Attempts to send messages result to an error saying: Message not delivered.
  • Messages appear sent however the recipient did not receive the actual SMS.
General inbound SMS failures Symptoms:
  • Sending parties receive a message stating that the Local RingCentral Number they are replying to is being detected as a landline number.
  • Not receiving SMS messages from a specific number.
  • Received SMS messages not showing up on the RingCentral application (RingCentral for Desktop; RingCentral Mobile Application; RingCentral Integration for Salesforce, Office 365, Google, and Outlook).
OUTBOUND SMS CALLERID ISSUES Symptoms:
  • Sent messages are being sent from the wrong Local RingCentral Number.
  • The user cannot select the desired Local RingCentral Number. as the CallerID.

fields.name: tile5f1
fields.fieldText:
OUTBOUND SMS CALLER ID ISSUES RingCentral customers will not be able to use certain numbers as CallerID for SMS if the Local RingCentral Number's SMS feature is Not Enabled. This can easily be identified by going to the Phone Numbers section in Admin Interface. The SMS Enabled column in Admin Interface will show the status of the local number's SMS messaging service. NOTE: If the SMS feature of the local number is Not Enabled, go back to the previous screen and select GENERAL ACTIVATION OF BUSINESS SMS. DETERMINE WHERE THE LOCAL NUMBER IS ASSIGNED The availability of the local numbers to be used as CallerID for SMS will depend on which user extension the local number is assigned. Below are the CallerID rules being followed when using RingCentral Business SMS:
  • The main number can only be used as the CallerID for SMS by the Operator Extension.
  • Any local number assigned to the Auto-Receptionist can only be used as the CallerID for SMS by the Operator Extension.
  • Any local number assigned to the user extension can only be used as the CallerID for SMS by the same user extension it is assigned with.
  • Any local number in the account whose SMS Enabled status is Not Enabled cannot be used as CallerID for SMS.

SECURITY SOFTWARE AND COMPUTER FIREWALL If the softphone is still unable to send SMS even after making sure that the softphone is up to date, the computer's security software and firewall may be blocking the traffic it's supposed to send to the RingCentral servers. Ask the customer to temporarily disable both security software and firewall.
  • Isolate the problem by disabling the security software. If the customer is unaware on how to do so, please refer the customer to their IT department or consultant.
  • Some security software may include a built-in firewall. Temporarily disabling the firewall feature will also help isolate the problem.
  • Temporarily disable any currently running firewall software.
Once the security software and firewall has been disabled, send an SMS again.
